title: Working the riverfront with white men; no segregation
summary: Second reel resumes on riverfront work. Glass says Black and white worked together and segregation came only lately.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up under segregation: schools, neighborhoods, Jim Crow

blocks.x: Oh, yeah. I got the second reel on... Let's see, today is April 19, 1972. We were talking about working on the riverfront, so you... You teamed up with the white fellows? Oh, yeah, yeah, we worked together. That was our gang, you know? Did you have any kind of segregation in those days?
No, no, no. That's all lately, huh? All lately, that come up. No, we didn't have no segregation. The whites and the colors were together. Screw them.
